title: Average Salary Predictions by Experience Level
summary: Based on 2160 predictions, the average salary increases with experience, especially for roles in Data Science and Machine Learning.
key_insights: As experience grows, so does the predicted salary.
Data Science and Machine Learning roles tend to be the highest-paying options.
The range of salaries is significant, with some roles costing up to $417,000.
